overview_description.description: Mirage (formerly known as Captions) is a video-generating, video-editing and AI research company headquartered in New York City. Their first app, Captions, is available on iOS, Android, and Web and offers a suite of tools aimed at streamlining the creation and editing of videos. Their enterprise platform, Mirage Studio, generates AI actors and videos for marketing assets and video campaigns.

about_short_description.short_description: Mirage is building foundation models and products that change the future of video.

product.name: Mirage Studio
product.description: A video generation platform that creates expressive videos with AI-generated actors that look and sound realistic, eliminating the need for recording.

product.name: AI Creator
product.description: A 3D avatar platform designed for content creation that enables instant generation of talking videos using AI avatars.

product.name: AI Video Editing
product.description: An AI-powered video editing service that applies selected editing styles to videos in real-time automatically.

product.name: AI-Powered Subtitling and Captioning
product.description: An AI-driven tool that automatically generates accurate subtitles and captions for videos, with customization and translation into multiple languages.

product.name: AI Translate
product.description: A service that translates video audio and captions into over 28 languages, synchronizing lip movements to match the translated speech.

product.name: DALL-E Integration
product.description: Integration of OpenAI's DALL-E 3 AI image generator within the video editing platform to create custom visuals from text prompts.
